name: F1 Live
description: Live race timing for your driver from F1's free live-timing feed: sector colours, race status, pit stops, penalties and position changes.

emits.f1.status: Track status changed (code: green, yellow, sc, vsc, vscending, red, chequered; label)
emits.f1.pit: Your driver pitted (phase in, then done with compound, new, stop, lane)
emits.f1.penalty: A penalty was given (driver, tla, mine, summary, message)
emits.f1.position: Your driver's position changed (from, to, gained)

options.label: My driver
options.description: Car number or three-letter code, e.g. 44 or HAM. You can also pick from the expanded island.

options.label: Sessions
options.description: races: Grands Prix and sprints only. all: practice and qualifying too.

options.label: Lap times island
options.description: Position, sector colours (purple, green, yellow) and last lap of your driver.

options.label: Race status
options.description: Yellow flags, VSC, safety car, red flag and the chequered flag.

options.label: Pit stop popup
options.description: New tyres, stop time and pit lane time when your driver pits.

options.label: Penalties for
options.description: all drivers, or only your driver.

options.label: Position pulse
options.description: Green ring when your driver gains a place, red when one is lost.
